files.summary: separate admitted AI session settings, reasoning effort and shared Worker costs
edits:
- [ ] Qualify the configured Contributor handoff through the [current Macrofold routes](../ai-providers.md#current-macrofold-routes): new harness Runs carry `model_parameters`; native inference carries reasoning/provider fields inside `input`, not a second top-level `model_parameters` object. Preserve the exact selected model and parameters through admission, idempotency, execution and usage provenance. Model/harness/parameters are supplied when creating a session; continuations inherit its accepted configuration and changed defaults apply to new sessions. The earlier local catalogue and live reflection observations retain their recorded scope; current remote eligibility and the remaining continuation cases still require validation.
- [ ] Verify all generation routes: immediate mini uses low, complex routes use independently selected low/high, and the configured actor harness retains its full-work parameter binding. CR02 and CR08 separate speech from reflection/dreams; the creator World Agent uses its own medium-effort profile. Qualify initial and continued calls without rewriting an admitted session: a continuation inherits its accepted model, billing mode, parameters and grants, while changed defaults apply to a newly admitted session. Preserve original pending operation identities and reconcile uncertainty before replacement; do not require a compatibility migration or automatic paid replay. Confirm reuse of the operator-selected Worker under [MW04](macrofold-worker-api.md#mw04--remaining-deployment-and-qualification-gates).
- [ ] Qualify `MACROFOLD_BILLING_MODE=byok` for new harness admissions, native fast/complex inference and Jev inference, without silent managed fallback. Catalogue validation for new sessions follows the selected billing mode; continuations retain their originally admitted mode rather than applying changed local defaults.
- [ ] Qualify the already documented optional `MACROFOLD_PROVIDER_CONNECTION_ID` and `MACROFOLD_JEV_CONNECTION_ID` settings through initial inference/run admission and applicable continuation paths. The Jev-specific connection falls back to the configured shared provider connection, not managed billing; when neither ID is supplied, verify configured BYOK resolution or an explicit unavailable result. These IDs select credentials stored in Macrofold, never raw keys in prompts or frontend code. [Setup](../live-ai-setup.md#macrofold-embeddings-and-postgresql) and the [configuration owner](../../apps/server/src/config.ts) already describe/implement the local settings; remaining remote credential and rejection behavior is acceptance work, not missing documentation or a second credential store.
- [ ] Verify session continuations preserve the model, billing mode, connection and permissions accepted at creation; they must not silently reinterpret an old managed session as BYOK after local defaults change. New sessions use the selected current billing mode. Check that continuation request bodies omit creation-only overrides, and keep original pending mutation IDs/bodies and actual charges intact during reconciliation. Do not introduce old-session conversion support; an uncertain accepted Run is reconciled, not replaced by another paid dispatch.
- [ ] Qualify model-provider BYOK separately from operator-owned shared Worker capacity. OpenLegend limits and accounts for attributable Run/Inference spending; it does not provision, renew or reserve shared compute for each character or creator session. Preserve actual historical charges in their original ledger scopes without restoring the removed per-sandbox allocation workflow. Reuse [Worker setup](../ai-providers.md#shared-worker-setup-and-cutover), [native Run allocation](../invention-budgets.md#native-worker-and-run-allocation) and MW04 rather than duplicate their remaining deployment work. Runtime/billing qualification remains deferred; this documentation reconciliation adds no paid calls.
- [ ] Verify actual per-route reasoning parameters instead of the superseded claim that every complex thought and harness call uses `"xhigh"`. The [shared helper](../../apps/server/src/macrofold-model.ts) defaults full execution to `"xhigh"` and other execution modes to `"low"`; [native inference](../../apps/server/src/macrofold.ts) then honors an explicit request-level reasoning effort. Its larger complex-output allowance is a separate limit, not proof of higher reasoning effort. New actor full-harness sessions use the full helper; the creator World Agent uses its separately configured `"medium"` profile. Continued sessions inherit their admitted configuration. Keep CR02’s independently chosen low/high bindings and remaining serialized-request/live qualification open; source inspection establishes local request construction, not remote forwarding, provider support or model quality.

files.summary: track the separate quick-action keyboard listener under current input-scope acceptance
edits:
**Open — qualify current layout/input boundaries and affected changes.** Prioritize actual collisions, short/narrow overflow, text scaling, popup placement, dismissed-picker movement, wheel-through and drag/click ambiguity. Preserve selection/drafts through pane adaptation; child dismissal must not close the parent. Existing spatial/hearing trackers retain full-scene, touch and assistive-device qualification. [World contract](../ui-ux/world-interaction.md)

**Current shortcut-scope gap:** [Quick actions](../../apps/client/src/ui/quick-actions.tsx) register a separate window-level listener for keys 1–3. It excludes native input/textarea/select targets and modifier keys, but does not inspect an already-handled event, IME composition, editable ancestors, semantic textbox/combobox targets or active dialog/menu scope. The [main keyboard handler](../../apps/client/src/main.tsx) checks those boundaries for its own shortcuts; returning from that handler does not gate the separate quick-action listener. Trace and qualify the actual downstream path with an enabled pin while a picker row, dialog control or supported editor owns focus. Repair any reachable background dispatch through a shared input-ownership boundary rather than another independently maintained selector list. Require no gameplay command or Talk opening from UI-owned input, while preserving deliberate world-scoped shortcuts. This is a source-confirmed missing guard, not a reproduced browser failure; existing native-input observations do not cover these other event origins or prove their event propagation.
